title: Live-Action Darwin's Game Film's Trailer Reveals More Cast
content: The staff for the live-action film of FLIPFLOPs ' Darwin's Game manga revealed a new trailer and poster visual for the film on Friday. The trailer reveals more cast members for the film. Idol group Snow Man member Raul will play antagonist Wang (seen above) in the film.
author: ANN

content: Vampires have been making a major comeback in popular media in recent years, with films, games, and anime reinventing the nocturnal blood-suckers to bring them back into the limelight.

title: Dragon Ball’s Official Canon is Missing Out on One of Dragon Ball GT’s Best Ideas
content: One of the most tragic races in the Dragon Ball universe continues to get content made about them, but only in mostly non-canon timelines , which feels like a further twist of the knife. The Tuffles deserved much more dignified storytelling because their planet was taken from them by the Saiyans.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action Quiztopia Series Adds 13 Cast Members
content: Netflix unveiled 13 new cast members for Quiztopia , its eight-episode live-action series of Reiichi Sugimoto and Shinkichi Kato 's Kokumin Quiz ( National Quiz ) manga, on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Want More Godzilla? Check Out Netflix’s Anime Movie Trilogy
content: After the release of Godzilla Minus Zero , the smash-hit follow-up to 2023’s Godzilla Minus One , fans of the kaiju franchise have been clamoring to find more content featuring their favorite reptilian titan.

title: 'Giant Ojousama' Reveals Additional Cast, Character Promo
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account for the television anime adaptation of Q Nikumura 's Giant Ojousama manga revealed additional cast and three character promotional videos on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Dragon Prince's Ill-Mated Betrothal Manga Ends, Gets 3-Chapter Epilogue
content: Manga artist Sango Sansan 's manga adaptation of Nanaki Ichinose 's The Dragon Prince's Ill-Mated Betrothal light novel series ended with its 32nd chapter, which NTT Solmare 's Comic CMOA manga service published on September 17.
